description: This file defines the 'Returns' class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Sale namespace. It provides methods for handling sale return operations such as adding, editing, deleting returns, retrieving return data, managing return histories, and computing various totals related to returns.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Model class for managing sale return data and operations within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Inserts a new return record into the database and returns the ID of the inserted record.

methods.name: editReturn
methods.description: Updates an existing return record identified by return_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteReturn
methods.description: Deletes a return record and its associated histories from the database.

methods.name: getReturn
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific return by its ID.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Retrieves a list of returns based on filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Returns the total count of returns matching specific filter criteria.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnStatusId
methods.description: Returns the total number of returns with a specific return status ID.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnReasonId
methods.description: Returns the total number of returns with a specific return reason ID.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnActionId
methods.description: Returns the total number of returns with a specific return action ID.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new history entry for a return, updating its status and optionally notifying the customer.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Removes all history records associated with a specific return.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves the list of history records for a specific return, with pagination.
